characters.name: Alatar
characters.appearance: old wizard with a very long white beard, deep blue robes, and a tall, pointed hat

scenes.setting: dusty, circular wizard's tower, filled with ancient books and glowing vials, night

shots.description: Wizard Alatar, with his long white beard, intently stirs a large, bubbling cauldron with a gnarled wooden ladle.
The cauldron bubbles vigorously, and a shimmering, glowing blue butterfly slowly emerges from the steam, fluttering upwards.
Alatar watches with a gentle smile as the glowing blue butterfly circles once around his head, then flies towards an open window.
